hostConfiguration.resourceScope: Kernel online CPUs, physical memory and collector affinity; cgroup quotas and workload affinity require separate admission

comparisonMetric: Native clone request through final drained cgroup counter acquisition, including service startup, runner and service shutdown. Boundary hashing and outside collector CPU are excluded.
limitations: Controlled shared host; no CPU affinity or exclusive host reservation.
Two pairs establish engineering orientation only, not final eight-pair statistical acceptance.
Current native clock, charged cgroup CPU/memory and observed drain are local observations; final Linux admission joins remain open.
No loaded-memory attestation or exhaustive dynamic-library custody.
Source and runtime-file boundary hashes are not loaded-memory attestation.
Application captures use ordinary uninstrumented owners; no actual callback/native-context dispatch attestation is claimed.
Charged memory is cgroup memory.peak, not simultaneous RSS; shared-cache charging and warm inventories affect it.
Retained local originals and private harnesses are not a portable sealed final campaign.
Two pairs per cell do not establish confidence bounds, causal slowdown or final majority-scenario acceptance.
Reported test durations can overlap across workers and do not identify removable overhead or add to native complete time.
No package-publication, other-platform or broad-competitor leadership claim.

crossCaptureInputVerification.scope: Exact resolved-path, byte-count and SHA-256 agreement for every repeated declared input path in all72 original before snapshots. Each original after snapshot was separately verified equal. This is declared input scope, not exhaustive loaded-memory custody.
